composites.name: bubble-column-demo
composites.description: Tiny BiRD 0D bubble-column bioreactor demo: aerobic microbial growth in a 20 L vessel under air sparging. Emits dissolved O2/CO2, biomass, gas holdup, and kLa each step.

gas_flow_rate_Lpm.description: Volumetric gas flow rate (L/min) at the sparger.

composites.name: bubble-column-with-viz
composites.description: BiRD bubble-column bioreactor demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar trajectories, written to the 'viz_html' store.

gas_flow_rate_Lpm.description: Volumetric gas flow rate (L/min) at the sparger.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

composites.name: reactor
composites.description: Standalone 0D (well-mixed) BiRD bioreactor: BiRDReactorProcess owns both gas-liquid transport (Higbie kLa, Henry's law, Wilke-Chang) and internal Monod biomass growth, wired to dissolved-species stores with a RAM emitter. This is the pre-refactor baseline that bird-01 must preserve after the transport/biomass responsibility split.

composites.name: coupled_reactor_cell
composites.description: Coupled bioreactor: BiRDTransportProcess (gas-liquid transport only, biomass-as-input) composed with MonodCellProcess (the trivial cell-side engine that owns biomass + O2/CO2 exchange) at shared dissolved-species stores. Exercises the reactor→cell feedback a single-process reactor cannot.
